## Spec-driven checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits
- [ ] Linked approved spec(s):
- [ ] Linked approved ADR(s) (or N/A):
- [ ] No hand-written production code
- [ ] Automated code review passes
- [ ] CodeQL security scan passes
- [ ] Unit tests pass
- [ ] Integration tests pass
- [ ] E2E tests pass
- [ ] Coverage >= 80%
- [ ] Coverage result: `XX.X%` (replace with actual numeric percentage)
